title: Federation install durability fence returns an untyped 500 and a global 423 hold when the state writer is congested
outcome: Federation install durability fence returns an untyped 500 and a global 423 hold when the state writer is congested
acceptance: When the federation install's durability fence cannot resolve within its budget because the state writer is busy, the outcome is a typed pending result that the caller retries under the same identity, not an untyped 500, consistent with the typed outcomes given to registration, evaluation and named-root.
A focused regression covers federation install under a delayed writer collect and shows that the link and the peers' admission recover without operator action.
